All five submitted short links again failed to resolve to listings through the sandbox's only available reader (the fetch tool), consistent with F-P24 (06:2x UTC read) and the 2026-11-14..19 redirect history — yet another same-day read; several independent same-day reads now, none confirming the short links through sandbox tooling.
